desc:
Cat Lady has lost all of her cats. Please find them for her.

Hidden object scavenger hunt with over a hundred cats to find, spread over several areas. Progress is saved, so you can come back any time to continue your search.

Find the Cats is also available on Steam for PC, Mac, and Linux.

Also play the sequels:
Cat Trip: https://www.roblox.com/games/6776370984/Cat-Trip
Cats in Finland: https://www.roblox.com/games/7053813479/Cats-in-Finland

🔔🔔🔔 Make sure to hit the FOLLOW button to get notified when there are updates 🔔🔔🔔
